tagline: A killer night, delivered to your door.
hero_title: You're invited to a killer evening.
hero_description: An ordinary night with friends? Not on our watch. Discover beautifully crafted, ready-to-host murder mystery party kits full of secrets, scandal, and a very suspicious guest list.
announcement: The first case is almost ready. Meet One Last Toast.
about_intro: Portland-based author, personal trainer by day, and the woman behind Maya's Murder Mysteries.
about_text:
I've always loved a good story, a little mystery, and any excuse to bring my favorite people together.

For years, my friends and I had a tradition of buying murder mystery party kits and getting together for a night of suspicious behavior, dramatic accusations, and a whole lot of laughter. They were always some of my favorite nights—the kind we'd still be talking about years later.

Then this year, I had a thought: why not try writing one myself?

I've always secretly dreamed of being an author. I love writing, creating characters, and coming up with stories that keep people guessing. So, between personal training clients and everyday life, I finally decided to put my imagination to work. And that's how Maya's Murder Mysteries came to life.

For me, these games are about so much more than solving a murder. They're about bringing people together, laughing until your stomach hurts, and creating memories you'll still be talking about years later. That's what made me fall in love with murder mystery parties, and it's exactly what I hope to share with you.
about_signoff: You bring the guests. I'll bring the murder.
footer_note: Made for memorable nights, marvelous suspects, and just a little murder.
